about.text: An Italian cow-milk cheese from the Veneto and Trentino plateau, made as fresh Pressato and as aged d'Allevo; DOP since 1996.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.
Pressato 20-40 days (semi-soft); d'Allevo 60 days to 15+ months (hard)

facts.v: Whole and skimmed milk, rice-grain curd, aged at least 60 d: Mezzano 4–6 mo, Vecchio 10–16 mo, Stravecchio 15+ mo
